crossRefs.note: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

translations.web: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her, and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”
translations.bsb: And when she had brought them to him to eat, he took hold of her and said, “Come lie with me, my sister!”
